name: Parade
summary: Card game where players add to a central parade and try to avoid collecting cards, lowest score wins.
rules_text: Shuffle 66 cards (6 colors 0-10). Deal 5 to each player, place 6 face up as parade line with front marked, remaining deck as draw pile. On your turn play 1 card from hand to the end of parade. If parade length before playing is greater than played value, count from the end ignoring the new card; all cards beyond that value enter removal mode. From those, you must take any card with same color as played card or value <= played value. Place taken cards face up in front of you by color. Close gaps in parade. If value is 0 all old cards are in removal mode. Then draw to 5 if deck remains. When any player has cards of all 6 colors or deck empties, each player including triggering player gets one final turn without drawing. Then each discards 2 cards from hand and adds remaining 2 to their collection. Scoring: per color, player(s) with most cards in that color (2+ more in 2-player) flips those cards to score 1 each; others score face values. Lowest total wins, tie fewest collected cards.
